questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I watched a movie yesterday.
questions.explanation: Verb stem + ました: Express a completed past action politely.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I did not eat breakfast.
acceptedAnswers: 朝ご飯を食べませんでした。
questions.explanation: Verb stem + ませんでした: Express that an action did not happen in the past.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I drink water.
questions.explanation: Noun + を + Verb: Mark the direct object affected by an action.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I study at the library.
questions.explanation: Place + で + Verb: Mark the place where an action happens.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I go toward school.
questions.explanation: Place + へ + movement verb: Mark the direction toward which someone moves.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I came to Tokyo.
questions.explanation: Place + に + movement verb: Mark a concrete destination or arrival point.
